scope: Three defensive source reviews and disposable local regression fixtures
status: validated locally, migration and deployment pending

tests.independent_mutation_queue_fixture: cross-document progress, permission revocation, failure recovery and queue cleanup passed
tests.malformed_request_fixture: local child server and local Nginx proxy, subsequent health request succeeds
tests.limits: Selected browser suites are not the entire Playwright suite. Focused Node checks are subsets of the complete run.

resource_sample.limit: Individual local measurements, not production capacity or latency guarantees

compatibility.index_formats: Existing inverted records remain version 3; compact records use version 4. Old readers rebuild rather than silently omit compact records.
compatibility.rollback_limit: Reverting also restores the old expensive index rebuild. Prefer roll-forward for untrusted content.

residuals: Storage billing counts revision payloads rather than total physical SQLite and index bytes.
Current head replacement collects its unused dictionary entries; historical purges are not globally swept.
Compact queries still consume total CPU, memory and IO even though they yield cooperatively.
Provider reconciliation coordination is process-local for the current single-process deployment.
Refresh hashes discarded before this release cannot be reconstructed.
This is not a penetration-test certification or a 100,000-document capacity certification.
